jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**
==============

Lantern is building the AI-native operating system for the $9T wholesale distribution industry. Billions of dollars sit tied up in stock, yet most distributors still buy on gut feel and spreadsheets. We partner with leading distributors to deliver precise, AI-powered purchasing recommendations that drive 30% leaner inventory, 10% higher sales, and 20+ hours saved per week per user. We've gone from $0 to $5M ARR in 8 months, raised $7M from top VCs, and are hitting hypergrowth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to scale the core ML platform behind our product: the production systems that ingest operational data, train models, and generate recommendations. The central challenge is making these workflows scalable, repeatable, observable, and easy to operate across hundreds of customers. You'll own the platform end to end, from data ingestion through training pipelines to inference and monitoring in production. It's a high-ownership role on a small team, working directly with our CTO to ship systems every customer relies on.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
==================

* Own and scale the ML and data pipelines that power Lantern's customer recommendations.
* Build reusable infrastructure for data ingestion, feature generation, model training, validation, and output.
* Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and observability as Lantern scales across more customers.
* Build systems that catch data-quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected outputs before they reach customers.
* Turn customer-specific workflows into repeatable, configuration-driven systems, and help shape the platform architecture.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
==================

* 4–6 years as an ML or Software Engineer building ML systems in production.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
* Experience building and scaling ML training and inference pipelines, ideally multi-tenant or per-customer.
* Hands-on with Python, cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), and orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow, or similar).
* Comfort with messy, real-world data.
* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**NICE TO HAVE**
================

* Supply chain, logistics, demand forecasting, or operations-adjacent experience.
* Time-series forecasting frameworks and traditional ML tools (XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn).
* Prior early-stage startup experience where you wore multiple hats.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET**
===================

* A founding-era, high-impact role at a hyper growth startup.
* Own the ML platform that drives customer P&L on every account.
* Make a massive positive impact across our entire supply chain and economy.
* Competitive compensation: ~$200K base + meaningful equity.
* An office in San Francisco with a tight-knit founding team.

**WHAT WE VALUE**
=================

We hire operators who own outcomes, combining sharp judgment with pragmatic execution and a willingness to do the unglamorous work. Hard work, humility, customer obsession, and pride in a job well done: the values our customers live by, and the values we hire for.

Compensation Range: $200K

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Intelligent Experiences, MLO
jobs.description:
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products - iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos.  
  
We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end.  
  
Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.  
  
**Description**  
  
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows - multi-step, tool-using LLM systems - that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.","responsibilities":"Design synthetic data generation pipelines - prompt/context engineering, generator/critic loops, diversity and contamination controls and prove the data's impact on model quality through controlled ablations  
  
Engineer agentic workflows (multi-step, tool-using, multi-agent LLM systems) or LLM-based flows (RAG, fine tuning) for curation, annotation, labeling QA, and evaluation, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints where they matter  
  
Define and run quality evaluation for synthetic assets: perceptual and reference-based metrics alongside VLM judges and human preference studies  
  
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and diffusion models for specific downstream tasks; run controlled ablations that isolate the contribution of each data intervention  
  
Partner cross-functionally with modeling, product, and privacy/legal teams to translate data tradeoffs into decisions, and identify strategic opportunities to improve our data capabilities  
  
Track and evaluate emerging techniques in data curation and generative AI, and make evidence-based recommendations about what to adopt  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks  
  
Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation  
  
Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection.  
  
Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality  
  
Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes  
  
Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale  
  
Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus  
  
Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (e.g., differential privacy, on-device data constraints) is a plus  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field  
  
5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity & revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US-based) to join our team. This is a full-time, hybrid role with frequent hands-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams.

**Product Description** Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care.

Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch:

* Design, train and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
* Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data.
* Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
* Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
* Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
* Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
* Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs.
* Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Nice to have

* Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA-style models) or open-vocabulary detection.
* Multi-object tracking and video analytics (re-identification, action recognition, temporal models).
* Few-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low-data domains.
* MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models.
* Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance.

Key Components

* Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications.
* Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing.
* Algorithm Implementation: Implement state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real-world scenarios.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems.
* On-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected.
* Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
* Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Problem-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems.

The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state-of-the-art neural networks to make an impact.

 **Requirements**  

* 3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
* Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade-offs made along the way.
* Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification.
* Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation.
* Working knowledge of model optimization for infere

In this role, you'll develop the algorithms that run our robotaxi fleet: matching vehicles to riders and other missions, staging vehicles where and when they're needed, routing, and pricing.

You'll also model what goes into those decisions: rider demand, the value of the data our R&D fleet collects, servicing needs, and business inputs like events and policies. You'll be the optimization generalist on the team, working alongside specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy, and you'll see your algorithms run on a real autonomous fleet. You’ll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry’s most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

* Design, prototype, and help deploy algorithms for vehicle assignment, staging, routing, and pricing
* Model the inputs to orchestration (rider demand, data-collection value, servicing needs, events, and policies) as objectives and constraints
* Work with specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy to turn their models into decisions the fleet acts on
* Measure impact on revenue, utilization, and rider experience through simulation, offline evaluation, and online experiments
* Contribute to how we evaluate and roll out orchestration improvements

* PhD or MS with 2+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in operations research, robotics, controls, transportation, computer science, applied math, or a related field
* Deep expertise in at least one of: combinatorial/integer optimization, stochastic optimization or control, reinforcement learning/approximate DP, network flows, or marketplace/demand modeling, plus the curiosity to work across the rest
* Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
* Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
* Good communication and collaboration skills

* Internship or research experience in ride-hailing, delivery, logistics, or AV fleets (dispatch, routing, rebalancing, pricing)
* Algorithms deployed in production or used on real operational data

jobs.title: Product Data Scientist - Youth, Families and Learning
jobs.description:
Data Science - San Francisco

**About the role**

We’re looking for a product data scientist to help OpenAI create more value and drive sustainable growth for young people, families, and learners. You’ll drive product data science across under-18 audiences, emerging opportunities for children under 13, family experiences, and learning and education more broadly.

You’ll help decide where we should invest, what we should build, and how we’ll know it is working. This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

You’ll partner across Chat Product, Growth, Foundations, SafeSys, and other teams, working closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers. **The role focuses and owns product value and growth while dedicated teams own policy and safety.**

**In this role, you will:**

* **Shape strategy and prioritize opportunities.** Size unmet needs and growth opportunities across audiences, use cases, and product experiences. Help teams choose where to invest and sequence work based on expected user value, reach, evidence, and effort.
* **Define what value and success mean.** Develop an audience-specific measurement framework spanning activation, task success, learning progress, satisfaction, and durable retention. Connect these measures to product goals and assess whether repeat use reflects meaningful benefit.
* **Understand users and growth drivers.** Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to uncover where people find value, where they struggle, and what helps them return. Combine behavioral data with surveys and user research to explain differences across ages, family roles, and learning contexts.
* **Measure what changes actually cause.** Design experiments and holdouts to evaluate product and model changes. Apply causal methods when randomization is impractical, make assumptions explicit, and account for seasonality, audience composition, and effects that differ across segments.
* **Turn findings into product decisions.** Work with partners from initial hypotheses through launch and iteration. Recommend what to build, change, expand, or stop, explaining expected impact, uncertainty, and tradeoffs. Follow through to determine whether decisions delivered the intended results.
* **Build reliable measurement.** Partner with engineering on instrumentation, dataset quality, and consistent audience definitions. Create reusable analyses and dashboards that make progress visible and let teams answer recurring questions independently.
* **Create alignment across teams.** Bring a coherent view of audience value to work spanning multiple roadmaps. Help partners agree on priorities, success criteria, and the next questions to resolve, even when ownership is distributed and evidence is incomplete.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* A record of influencing product strategy and improving user outcomes through hands-on data science, including work from an ambiguous question to a decision and measurable impact.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, sound statistical judgment, and practical experience with experiments, causal inference, cohort analysis, and measurement design.
* The ability to develop useful definitions of product value, validate imperfect proxies, and distinguish short-term metric movement from lasting improvement.
* Clear communication and strong product judgment. You can make a recommendational authority.

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.

Reliability Platform's long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.

**About the Role**

As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you'll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team's mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.

We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.

Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:

* Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands
* Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products
* Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Deliver Innovative Capabilities**: You don't want to 'turn the crank' somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.

* **Hold a High Quality Bar:** We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
**What we do**  
  
Delphi, Uber's Lever Efficiency team, builds the system Uber uses to recommend how to invest billions of dollars per year across its marketplace supply and demand levers: courier pricing (supply), courier incentives (supply), delivery and service fees (demand), user promotions (demand), etc. Starting with Uber's Delivery Marketplace business, we turn experiment results into a measure of each lever's incremental value in a common currency and publish it in a dashboard that refreshes automatically. We're also building a budget allocation tool that recommends how to move budget between levers. We work day to day with data scientists, product, operations, and finance.
  
  
**Why it matters**  
  
Today each lever spends against its own budget target, even after it starts hitting diminishing returns. A trusted, comparable measure of what each lever returns lets Uber move money to where it does the most good: more reliable deliveries for customers, more earning opportunities for couriers, and more long-term growth for every dollar spent. The hard part is making the numbers trustworthy enough that Operations and Finance leaders act on them. Then the recommendations have to be proven with well-designed experiments. That's the system you'll help build.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in an engineering related bootcamp
* 2+ years of experience in professional software development experience, developing and deploying systems in production environments
* Proven skills writing efficient, clean code in Go, Java, or Python
* Ability to debug and fix software bugs in a production scale environment
* Experience with software engineering best practices
* Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: caching, sharding, consensus, fault tolerance, observability, and incident response
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architectures and algorithms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced coursework or industry background in statistics, causal inference, or experimental design.
* Direct ownership of analysis workflows (A/B, quasi-experimental, marketplace simulations) at scale.
  + Python, Pandas, PySpark
  + Data Pipelines (e.g. Spark, Scala)
  + Jupyter Notebooks
* Fullstack development experience (BE, FE, Data Pipelines), this project involves a full suite of development surfaces across UI, backend, and data.
* Experience developing internal tooling used by Ops, Engineers, Finance, Scientists, etc.

**What the Candidate Will Do**

* Build and own data pipelines (Spark, Hive, scheduled workflows) that recompute lever-efficiency estimates from experiment and marketplace data every week. Include data-quality checks, freshness alerts and backfills.
* Build backend services and APIs in Go that store and serve efficiency estimates and budget recommendations.
* Ship full-stack features in the web app: interactive dashboards and a budget allocation tool used by Operations, Finance, Product, and Science.
* Work with data scientists to turn notebook prototypes into production code. This includes confidence intervals, corrections for network effects, forecasts, and an optimizer that moves budget between levers within real constraints, such as fixed total spend and capped weekly changes.
* Work with Uber's experimentation platform to run experiments that test budget moves (switchbacks, geo experiments, synthetic control), and automate reading their results into the dashboard.
* Take features from design to launch: write design docs, review code, test, monitor production, and take part in on-call.
Document methodology and system design so partners can trust and reuse the numbers.  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals in C++, Python, or Rust
* Experience with networking, IPC, and communication protocols for hardware-software systems (e.g., gRPC, DDS, MQTT, WebSockets)

**Nice to Have (But Not Required)**

* Experience building telemetry and observability systems for embedded or edge platforms
* Familiarity with perception pipelines or control systems and how they interact with the broader robot stack

**Why This Role**

* Your work is the connective tissue of the robot — the networking, monitoring, data, and tooling infrastructure you build directly determines how fast the team can develop, debug, deploy and improve our robots in the field
* Work across the full onboard stack alongside perception, control, and ML engineers on a platform that is pushing the frontier of what robots can do
* High ownership in a small, fast-moving team where your contributions shape the development velocity and reliability of the next generation of robots

**About the Team**
------------------

We’re hiring a Developer Productivity engineer to support OpenAI’s Inference Runtime teams. These teams own the systems responsible for serving models reliablyance.

This role sits at the intersection of developer experience, CI/CD infrastructure, release engineering, production readiness, and inference systems reliability. You’ll work on the tooling and operational foundations that support model launches, inference optimizations, cloud provider integrations, and large-scale deployments across a rapidly evolving inference stack.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for an autonomous, high-ownership engineer who cares deeply about making other engineers faster, safer, and more confident.

A major focus of this role will be improving the tooling and infrastructure around deploy gates for inference engine images. These systems help ensure that every image released to production and research is correctant across key metrics like time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT).

You’ll help harden the systems that catch issues before they reach production, reduce noise from flaky or infrastructure-related test failures, and improve automation around triage, ownership, debugging, and escalation when failures occur. You’ll also work on improving observability, rollout safety, release automation, and developer self-service tooling across a rapidly evolving inference stack.

This is not generic internal tools work. The systems you build directly impact OpenAI’s ability to support new model launchess in the world.

In this role, you will:

* Improve systems that ensure inference engine releases are correctant, and regression-free by evolving tooling and infrastructure for deploy gate validation
* Bring rigor to release, validation, branching, and deployment processes across the inference stack
* Improve canary, async, and large-scale validation workflows for inference systems
* Harden CI, testing, and validation infrastructure so failures are actionable and trustworthy
* Reduce noisy or flaky failures caused by infrastructure instability, GPU scheduling, or test environment issues
* Build automation for failure triage, ownership detection, debugging, and escalation
* Partner closely with inference teams, research developer productivity, engine acceleration, and infrastructure teams to improve release quality and rollout safety
* Reduce developer friction in testing, debugging, and release workflows so engineers can move faster with confidence

**You might thrive in this role if:**
-------------------------------------

* You have strong experience with CI/CD systems, testing infrastructure, release tooling, developer productivity, or large-scale build and validation systems
* You are excited by high-impact infrastructure where small regressions in correctness, latency, or reliability meaningfully affect production systems
* You care about building systems engineers can trust, not just systems that technically function
* You have strong developer empathy and enjoy improving workflows, reducing friction, and making engineers more effective
* You demonstrate high ownership and proactively identify problems, drive improvements, and follow issues through resolution

**About OpenAI**

jobs.title: Validation & Tooling Software Engineer, Residential Energy Products
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Tesla Energy Device Software team is looking for a Software Engineer to design and maintain the internal tooling and simulation infrastructure that lets residential energy firmware teams move faster with higher confidence. You will work across Powerwall, Backup Gateway, Wall Connector, and related home energy products—building Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments that approach real-world behavior, and the visualization and debugging tools that make complex multi-process systems understandable.

Device software is only as good as the feedback loop around it. Our goal is tooling that shortens the path from idea to validated behavior: high-fidelity SIL, field-trace capture and replay, rich reports and dashboards, control-flow and system visibility, and extensible instrumentation (traces, hooks, probes). As products, revisions, capabilities, and regional variants grow—including market-specific configurations such as external companion hardware—you will regularly extend the platform so new and existing products can be brought into the same validation and debugging workflow.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain internal SIL, harness, and developer tooling (primarily Python and Go) that improves correctness, debuggability, and release confidence for residential energy device software
* Build and evolve close-to-real-life SIL environments for multi-process embedded Linux systems; close gaps between simulation and field behavior where they matter most
* Develop visualization and debugging tools—including report generation, SIL-driven dashboards, control-flow visualization, and related analysis views—so engineers can understand system behavior without spelunking logs alone
* Implement and support trace/hook/instrumentation systems that reach into device software (Go, Rust, C/C++); enable capture of traces in the field and faithful replay in SIL
* Onboard new products, product revisions, capabilities, and regional or market-specific configurations (e.g. installations that require additional external hardware) into shared tooling and SIL workflows
* Collaborate with Product, Device Software, Hardware, and Validation to turn team pain points into clear tool designs, tests, and shippable internal platforms
* Improve reliability and usability of tooling used daily by engineers; reduce time-to-root-cause for lab, SIL, and field issues
* Contribute to automated tests, CI integration, and engineering practices that raise product reliability, developer productivity, and release confidence
* Support production and fleet needs where tooling helps: bring-up, field anomaly reproduction, and continuous improvement after launch

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work in an extremely fast-paced, collaborative environment
* Experience building internal developer, validation, or simulation tooling that other engineers rely on day to day
* Proficiency in languages used for tooling and integration—Python, Go; Rust, C, or C++ experience is a plus for working close to device software and multi-process systems
* Comfort working across the boundary between tools and the systems under test: embedded or device software, multi-process Linux, IPC, logs, and traces
* Real-world experience in one or more of: Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), simulation harnesses, or high-fidelity test environments for embedded or multi-process systems; Debug, visualization, or observability tooling (dashboards, report generators, timeline/control-flow views, or similar); Trace, instrumentation, capture/replay, or hook-based systems for reproducing field or lab scenarios offline; Extending test or simulation platforms to support new products, hardware variants, or regional configurations
* Strong software fundamentals: clear interfaces, maintainability, failure handling, and testability—tooling is product software for internal users
* Experience with unit / integration automation, CI pipelines, or HIL-style validation adjacent to SIL is a plus
* Experience with Docker and QEMU (or similar container and machine emulation tooling) is a plus for packaging, isolation, and realistic SIL environments
* Exposure to complex embedded Linux systems, home energy / battery / inverter products, multi-device site setups, or market-specific product variants is a plus

jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You'll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

* Develop and maintain Python-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces.

* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering embedded Linux systems
* Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication.

* Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS-232, USB-serial) and SDK-based hardware integration.
* Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration.
* Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale.
* Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices.

### ***Why You'll Love This Role***

* Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption.
* Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering.
* End-to-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability.
* Collaborative culture: Deep cross-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences.
* Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale.

This total compensation will include base salary and new hire equity package (in Restricted Stock Units) for this position at CLEAR. jobs.description:
Data Scientist

Hybrid (New York City) or remote within the United States

About Pure Earth:

Pure Earth is a growing international nonprofit addressing one of the most urgent yet solvable global health crises: toxic pollution and its profound impacts on human health. We specialize in preventing exposure to lead and other toxins in low- and middle-income countries, embedding solutions into government systems that outlast any single project or grant.

With substantial multi-year funding through the Audacious Project, Bloomberg Philanthropies, Coefficient Giving, and other partners, secured through 2033, Pure Earth is leading one of the largest concentrated efforts ever undertaken to end childhood lead poisoning. We are scaling proven interventions across dozens of countries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia, working in partnership with governments, multilateral organizations, leading philanthropies, and frontline organizations to identify exposure sources, mitigate contamination, and improve policies and regulation.

Pure Earth holds top ratings from Charity Navigator and Candid, and our work has been featured on the TED mainstage and across major news and global health outlets. At Pure Earth, you'll join an agile, mission-driven team that translates science and innovation into measurable impact, with the resources, partnerships, and ambition to deliver change at scale.

Position Overview:

Pure Earth seeks a Data Scientist to strengthen our organization-wide monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) systems during a period of significant growth. In this new role, reporting to the Director of MEL, you will be a hands-on analyst and advisor to headquarters (HQ) and country program teams: designing implementation research, analyzing and disseminating programmatic data, and turning findings into actionable programmatic or policy decisions.

You will work with researchers, program managers, and policymakers across multiple countries. You will analyze messy, real-world data, design implementation research protocols, and build statistical models that show whether and how our interventions work. Your findings will shape program strategy, inform government policy, and add to the global evidence-base on toxic pollution and health.

We are looking for someone who combines rigorous analytical and study-design skills with experience of large-scale public health programs, is comfortable with ambiguity, builds strong working relationships, and wants to help build new systems in a growing organization.

Reporting and Team Structure:

Reports to: Director, Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning

Direct reports: None

Key internal partners: VP of Programs and Programs Department staff at HQ and in country offices

Work Location:

Hybrid New York City or remote

Employment Type:

Full-Time, Exempt

Scope of Work:

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Implementation Research

* Design implementation research protocols and lead studies with HQ departments and country teams, from sampling and study design through data analysis and dissemination.

* Ensure studies meet ethical review (IRB) and data protection requirements, including for data collected from children and other vulnerable groups.

* Lead or support country teams in analyzing study and program data using advanced statistical methods (e.g., regression, mixed-effects and Bayesian models) and, where appropriate, machine learning and AI-assisted tools.

* Lead the writing of reports, policy briefs, blogs, and peer-reviewed publications, and represent Pure Earth at scientific and technical conferences and meetings.

Data Science Capacity and Learning

* Build staff skills in data analysis and data use so that teams can analyze the program data they collect.

* Design and facilitate learning mechanisms (e.g., workshops, learning events) that promote cross-team learning, reflection, and decision-making, and train teams to use them.

* Document lessons learned and co-develop knowledge products that assess current data collection protocols and approaches, guide program strategy, communicate findings, and contribute to the sector-wide evidence base.

* Make complex data and findings accessible to non-technical internal and external audiences.

* Manage, analyze, and communicate both quantitative and qualitative data for program learning, strategy, fundraising, and communications.

MEL Systems and Project Design

* Advise on the continued development of Pure Earth’s MEL systems, processes, and tools so they capture progress, results, and lessons learned across major new projects.

* Support the development of proposals, concept notes, and funder-compliant project MEL plans aligned with Pure Earth’s program logic.

* Support efficient data collection for project and global indicators, including training staff on data collection tools and methods.

* Coach and train remote and distributed teams.

Success in the First 6 Months:

* Has made substantive contributions to design of organizational Management Information Systems (MIS) for MEL data.

* Has supported coaching and training of in-country staff on implementation research and programmatic data analysis.

* Has led development of 1–3 implementation research protocols.

* Has supported development of learning agendas and evaluation priorities

Required Qualifications and Experiences:

Education

* Degree in public health, epidemiology, statistics, data science, or a related field, with one of the following: PhD and 6 years of relevant experience; master’s degree and 8 years; or bachelor’s degree and 10 years (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).

Experience

* At least 5 years designing and running implementation research or evaluation studies. and analyzing real-world program data, preferably in the international nonprofit sector.

* Advanced statistical skills, including sampling and study design, regression, and mixed-effects or Bayesian modeling.

* Proficiency in R,

At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.

**About the role**

Gap Inc. is seeking a Data Scientist to join our Product-to-Market (P2M) Data Science team. P2M encompasses the decisions that shape how products move from planning to the customer, including what products to carry, how much inventory to buy, where and how inventory should be positioned, and how products should be priced and promoted. Our team applies machine learning, optimization, and analytics to improve these decisions across P2M lifecycle.This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who has strong quantitative and programming fundamentals and wants to solve real-world retail problems at scale. jobs.description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. **GenAI Fullstack Engineer | About the Role**

As a GenAI Fullstack Engineer, you will design and build scalable enterprise applications that combine robust Java-based backend engineering with modern Generative AI capabilities. * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Security, and Spring Data/JPA.
* Build and integrate production-grade GenAI and LLM applications, connecting AI services with existing Java/Spring Boot enterprise applications and business systems.
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, semantic search, context retrieval, reranking, and response generation.

* Integrate LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Gemini, or Llama, applying prompt engineering, response evaluation, guardrails, and optimization techniques to improve solution accuracy and reliability.
* Build secure and observable AI/backend services by implementing authentication, authorization, exception handling, logging, monitoring, API security, and production-grade engineering standards.
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, collaborating with architects, data engineers, developers, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable GenAI solutions.

**GenAI Fullstack Engineer | Skills & Experience**

* Strong software engineering 3+ years experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST APIs, including hands-on experience designing scalable and distributed enterprise backend applications.
* Hands-on experience developing production GenAI/LLM applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, response evaluation, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Strong production experience with RAG architectures, including embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, reranking, context construction, and RAG quality optimization.
* Strong working knowledge of Python and FastAPI, with experience building AI/ML services and integrating Python-based AI components with Java/Spring Boot applications.
* Hands-on experience with Vector Databases and GenAI frameworks, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face.
* Experience with cloud and modern deployment practices, including AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production deployment of AI services.
* Additional exposure to Agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI guardrails, LLMOps, Kubernetes, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, and event-driven microservices is advantageous.

jobs.description:
**About Within**  
  
Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year.

Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.

Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.

ServiceNow mapped 900+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.

OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.

We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

**AI Front-end Engineer @ Within**
==================================

**Experience:** 1-2 years of shipping production code (or exceptional new grads with strong portfolios)  
**Location:** San Francisco / Bay Area (Relocation assistance available)  
**Job Type:** Full-time

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for an AI Front-end Engineer who wants to learn at the intersection of product design and frontend engineering. You care deeply about craft and have strong frontend fundamentals, but you're early in your career and hungry to grow. You'll work directly with senior engineers and designers to build AI-native workflows that make complex enterprise tools feel intuitive.

**Note:** We do not require a CS or Engineering degree. We care about your portfolio, side projects, and your hunger to learn and ship.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Strong frontend fundamentals with design sensibility** - You're comfortable with React and have built real projects. You understand the basics of component architecture and care about how things look and feel. You're excited to learn the nuances of performance optimization and advanced patterns.
* **Familiar with modern web technologies** - You've worked with React, TypeScript, and CSS frameworks like Tailwind. You may not have mastered them yet, but you're eager to learn best practices and write cleaner code every day.
* **AI-curious and eager to experiment** - You've tried tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or v0.dev and see their potential to accelerate your work. You're excited to learn how to use AI tools effectively to prototype faster and focus on solving hard problems.
* **Hungry to ship quickly and learn from feedback** - You care about getting features in front of users and iterating based on what you learn. You're willing to make tradeoffs and understand that done is often better than perfect when you're learning.
* **Detail-oriented and quality-conscious** - You notice when things feel off—animations that are janky, layouts that shift, or colors that don't quite work. You want to build things that feel good to use, even if you're still learning how to achieve that consistently.
* **Collaborative and coachable** - You ask good questions, take feedback well, and are excited to learn from people with more experience. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" and then figuring it out.
* **Energized by hard problems** - You see challenging UI problems as opportunities to grow. You bring enthusiasm and a positive attitude even when things are ambiguous or difficult.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Ship real features used by Fortune 500 customers** - Build production UI components, integrate with backend APIs, and contribute to features that ship to real users. You'll get code reviews and mentorship from senior engineers.
* **Learn to build scalable front-end systems** - Work within existing component libraries and patterns, contributing new components and learning best practices for state management, API integration, and performance optimization.
* **Collaborate across design and engineering** - Work with designers to implement their vision and with backend engineers to understand what's possible. You'll learn how to balance technical constraints with user experience goals.
* **Grow your craft rapidly** - You'll work directly with senior engineers on real problems, getting hands-on experience with AI-powered workflows, enterprise-scale applications, and modern frontend architecture. A small team means your growth happens fast.

**What You'll Learn**
---------------------

* How to build AI-native interfaces at production quality
* Advanced React patterns and performance optimization
* How to collaborate with designers and product managers
* How to use AI tools to multiply your productivity
* What great enterprise UX looks like (and how to build it)

**About our Benefits**
----------------------

* **Equity** in addition to competitive cash compensation
* **100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision options!**
* Paid Parental Leave
* $500 Annual Learning Fund
* $150 Monthly Wellness Fund
* 401k via Betterment
* Relocation support to San Francisco Bay Area (where applicable)
* Office-related Perks:

  + **BART or Caltrain to the office?**: Contribute pre-tax funds to a Parking & Transit account, and you will never be taxed for it!
  + **Lunchtime, Leveled Up**: Enjoy curated local eats delivered to the office daily to enjoy with the team over an engaging conversation
  + **Snack Central**: Drinks and snacks for every craving - from healthy bites to Within team favorites.
  + **Safe & Secure Bike Room**: Commute in and safely store your bike.

*Within is an equal opportunity employer. Within provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $140K - $205K

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring Backend + Applied AI Engineers to build the core systems that power Within's multimodal agents in real enterprise environments. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems and applied AI: you'll design and ship backend services that ingest messy real-world data, orchestrate model/agent workflows, enforce enterprise-grade security and deliver reliable outcomes at scale.

You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers to turn ambitious AI capabilities into production-grade features that Fortune 500 enterprises can depend on. We care deeply about engineering fundamentals (correctness, observability, security, performance) and equally about iteration speed - because in this space, only the teams who ship quality products & features at incredible velocity win.

You'll be paired with senior engineers who'll accelerate your growth, but you'll own real features from day one - we don't believe in extended bench time.

**Note**: We do not require a CS or Engineering degree. We care about your ability to ship, your systems thinking, and evidence of strong execution - whether through production work, open-source contributions, research, or high-quality side projects.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Backend engineer with sharp product judgment** - You design and build services, APIs, data models, and infrastructure that are reliable, observable, secure, and fast. You're building strong instincts for architectural tradeoffs and you actively seek feedback on your design decisions. You optimize for outcomes - developer velocity, latency, correctness, uptime - and not just for elegance in the abstract.
* **Systems thinker** - You're developing the muscle to see around corners. While solving today's stated requirements, you anticipate how services will need to evolve - functionally and non-functionally. You design for the future but build for the present, and you ask good questions about why things are built a certain way and push back when complexity isn't justified.
* **Applied AI builder who ships to production** - You're energized by LLMs, multimodal agents, orchestration protocols, and the messy work of making the entire AI stack reliable. You think instinctively in terms of evals, model regression tests, traceability, and exception handling. You've built at least one meaningful AI-powered project - whether production, open-source, or a serious side project - and you understand the gap between a working demo and a reliable system.
* **AI-native developer across the entire SDLC** - You wield tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot as extensions of your craft. You are extremely confident to run concurrent agents doing your chores reliably. You use AI to generate technical designs, scaffold APIs, draft schemas, write tests, and build migration plans. You're hungry to master these workflows and are already noticeably faster than peers who haven't embraced AI tooling.
* **Ship with velocity and craft** - You find the shortest path to get features into users' hands while obsessing over the details that create trust. You can calibrate the tradeoff between speed and tech debt, and you welcome guidance on where the line is. You believe speed and quality aren't opposites - they happen together when you're thoughtful about how you build.
* **Bring energy that elevates the entire team** - You see gnarly distributed systems challenges as puzzles waiting to be solved. Your optimism, intensity, and passion for craft are contagious. You make everyone around you faster and more ambitious. You also frequently cross-pollinate learnings by seeking and sharing them with the team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Build the backbone of Within's AI platform** - Design, experiment, build, test, and deploy the backend services that power everything our users use. You'll own meaningful components of critical infrastructure - shipping features end-to-end with increasing scope and autonomy: from data ingestion and storage to API design, background processing, and deployment architecture.
* **Turn AI pipelines into resilient workflows** - Implement AI orchestration pipelines that hold up under real-world variability. You'll work with structured outputs, tool calling, state management, grounding, and other guardrails to ensure agents behave reliably at scale. You'll start by building and extending evals, adding guardrails, and hardening existing pipelines - rapidly developing the judgment to design new ones.
* **Design for the future, ship for today** - Balance long-term architectural vision with relentless shipping cadence. You'll make pragmatic decisions that keep the codebase healthy and the product moving forward - developing judgment on when to take on deliberate tech debt with the support of senior engineers.
* **Build for enterprise security and scale** - Design

new_jobs.description:
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products - iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos.  
  
We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end.  
  
Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.  
  
**Description**  
  
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows - multi-step, tool-using LLM systems - that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.","responsibilities":"Design synthetic data generation pipelines - prompt/context engineering, generator/critic loops, diversity and contamination controls and prove the data's impact on model quality through controlled ablations  
  
Engineer agentic workflows (multi-step, tool-using, multi-agent LLM systems) or LLM-based flows (RAG, fine tuning) for curation, annotation, labeling QA, and evaluation, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints where they matter  
  
Define and run quality evaluation for synthetic assets: perceptual and reference-based metrics alongside VLM judges and human preference studies  
  
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and diffusion models for specific downstream tasks; run controlled ablations that isolate the contribution of each data intervention  
  
Partner cross-functionally with modeling, product, and privacy/legal teams to translate data tradeoffs into decisions, and identify strategic opportunities to improve our data capabilities  
  
Track and evaluate emerging techniques in data curation and generative AI, and make evidence-based recommendations about what to adopt  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks  
  
Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation  
  
Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection.  
  
Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality  
  
Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes  
  
Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale  
  
Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus  
  
Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (e.g., differential privacy, on-device data constraints) is a plus  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field  
  
5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines

The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fleet Orchestration Algorithms
new_jobs.description:
The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll develop the algorithms that run our robotaxi fleet: matching vehicles to riders and other missions, staging vehicles where and when they're needed, routing, and pricing.

You'll also model what goes into those decisions: rider demand, the value of the data our R&D fleet collects, servicing needs, and business inputs like events and policies. You'll be the optimization generalist on the team, working alongside specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy, and you'll see your algorithms run on a real autonomous fleet. You’ll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry’s most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Design, prototype, and help deploy algorithms for vehicle assignment, staging, routing, and pricing
* Model the inputs to orchestration (rider demand, data-collection value, servicing needs, events, and policies) as objectives and constraints
* Work with specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy to turn their models into decisions the fleet acts on
* Measure impact on revenue, utilization, and rider experience through simulation, offline evaluation, and online experiments
* Contribute to how we evaluate and roll out orchestration improvements

### **Qualifications**

* PhD or MS with 2+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in operations research, robotics, controls, transportation, computer science, applied math, or a related field
* Deep expertise in at least one of: combinatorial/integer optimization, stochastic optimization or control, reinforcement learning/approximate DP, network flows, or marketplace/demand modeling, plus the curiosity to work across the rest
* Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
* Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
* Good communication and collaboration skills

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Internship or research experience in ride-hailing, delivery, logistics, or AV fleets (dispatch, routing, rebalancing, pricing)
* Algorithms deployed in production or used on real operational data
* Publications in operations research, transportation, or robotics venues

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.

We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.

* Work with senior data scientists to troubleshoot, improve, and operationalize analytical solutions

new_jobs.title: Research Engineer, RL Frontiers
new_jobs.description:
### **Job Summary**

Etched is building AI systems that accelerate its own development. As a Research Engineer on the RL Frontiers team, you will train our proprietary frontier models to automate kernel development, ASIC engineering, production pipelines, and 3-D hardware operating systems.

You will use our proprietary simulators and environments to create custom data mixes and post-train models to SOTA performance on our hardest engineering tasks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the post-training stack completely end to end.
* Build RL environments with ASIC, kernel, and supercomputing engineers, rewarded by simulation, formal tools, tests, and hardware measurements.
* Create custom data mixes that unlock frontier performance on relevant tasks.
* Create benchmarks that drive real productivity in the models and avoid reward hacking

### **You may be a good fit if you**

* Have hands-on post-training experience, including SFT and RL (e.g., PPO, GRPO), and have shipped models people used.
* Have taken a model from bad to good on a task it wasn’t built for, ideally with scarce data, for example as an early post-training hire at an applied AI company.
* Are a strong PyTorch and distributed-training engineer who reads the rollouts and checks the numbers before trusting a result.
* Understand the systems side of RL well enough to make the loop faster and cheaper, not just better.
* Are entrepreneurial and make good calls under compute and data constraints. Former founders are a plus.

### **Strong candidates may also have experience with**

* RL or post-training frameworks (e.g., verl, OpenRLHF, TRL, prime-rl) or inference engines (vLLM, SGLang).
* Agentic, multi-turn RL with verifiable rewards.
* Distillation and training small, specialized models for production.
* ASIC design or verification, accelerator kernels, or large-scale compute infrastructure.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage

  + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

### **Base Compensation Range**

* $400K+
* Plus Significant Equity

### **How we’re different**

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

### **About Etched**

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Reliability Platform
new_jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.

Reliability Platform's long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you'll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team's mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.

We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.

Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:

* Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands
* Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products
* Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks
* Set up MCP for agentic use of Reliability Platform data + tools and enable other Core Infra teams to follow suit

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Deliver Innovative Capabilities**: You don't want to 'turn the crank' somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.
* **Be Customer Obsessed:** We want to learn from our internal customers to ensure we are solving the right challenges, and also share our perspective to influence in areas of expertise
* **Hold a High Quality Bar:** We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.
* **Automate Everything:** Your first instinct is to ask how toil can be obviated or, failing that, automated away from humans.
* **Shape the Future of Operations**: Experiment with agentic AI workflows that can propose, validate, and safely execute production changes — moving DoorDash toward proactive, self-healing systems in step with industry first movers.

**We're excited about you because you have…**

* Platform Engineering Mindset: You think in terms of APIs, abstractions, and workflows — you enjoy building systems that other engineers depend on every day.

* Cloud/Infra Expertise: You're comfortable with AWS primitives, security best practices, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

**About DoorDash**

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product Infrastructure - Agent Runtime

**About the Team**
------------------

Agent Runtime builds the shared agent primitives and compute runtime that power OpenAI products and applications. As agents take on more complex, longer-running tasks, we build the systems that let them maintain state, use tools, and work reliably in the environments they need.

We work closely with Research, Product, and infrastructure teams to turn advances in model capabilities into useful products. Our work combines deep systems engineering with a clear understanding of customer needs, creating reusable foundations that help teams build and scale new agent experiences.

With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You'll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

### ***What You Will Do***

* Architect and implement OS-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks).

About Pure Earth:

Pure Earth is a growing international nonprofit addressing one of the most urgent yet solvable global health crises: toxic pollution and its profound impacts on human health. We specialize in preventing exposure to lead and other toxins in low- and middle-income countries, embedding solutions into government systems that outlast any single project or grant.

With substantial multi-year funding through the Audacious Project, Bloomberg Philanthropies, Coefficient Giving, and other partners, secured through 2033, Pure Earth is leading one of the largest concentrated efforts ever undertaken to end childhood lead poisoning. We are scaling proven interventions across dozens of countries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia, working in partnership with governments, multilateral organizations, leading philanthropies, and frontline organizations to identify exposure sources, mitigate contamination, and improve policies and regulation.

Pure Earth holds top ratings from Charity Navigator and Candid, and our work has been featured on the TED mainstage and across major news and global health outlets. At Pure Earth, you'll join an agile, mission-driven team that translates science and innovation into measurable impact, with the resources, partnerships, and ambition to deliver change at scale.
